title: onobrychis sativa subsp. supina
intro: Onobrychis sativa subsp. supina, commonly known as Esparsette or Spanish Clover, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerative effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Onobrychis sativa subsp. supina contribute to its potential therapeutic uses, including the management of gastrointestinal issues and the promotion of overall well-being.
